answer: A payout is split thus 55% arrives at settlement and the rest over 6 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The whisper schedule is applied in tide and jade reveals each instalment. An adversary as a result cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 2467 identities would post 1396 proofs and burn roughly 25 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
